I am a man of 41 years, farming this small piece of land in Lilongwe. My plot is only small, less than a quarter hectare, and maize is what feeds my family. I will try to get some fertilizer through the government subsidy program if I can, because our soils here are tired and maize without fertilizer gives very little. I keep a few chickens and goats so I put their manure on the field, and I intercrop with beans to help the soil. I cannot afford to irrigate or hire much labor — my wife and children help me, and we work with hoes when the rains come.
